description_en: Sets whether a custom topic supports retained message broadcasting
description_zh: 调用该接口设置自定义Topic是否支持保留消息广播
name: UpdateTopicConfig

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter has a value, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device that receives messages belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要接收消息的设备所属产品的ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether retained message broadcasting is supported.

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持保留消息广播。

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: enable_broadcast

parameters.help_en:
The custom topic to which broadcast messages are sent.


For <props="china"><ph>open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic is the original custom topic of the device. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433806.html.
For <props="china"><ph>non-open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>non-MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic is in the format of `/broadcast/${productKey}/${customField}`. The `${productKey}` value must be the same as the ProductKey request parameter, and `${customField}` is a custom field that you define.

<notice> 
Topics are defined during device development and do not need to be created in the console.
The operation permission of the topic must be Subscribe or Publish and Subscribe.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要广播消息的自定义Topic。


对于<props="china"><ph>开源MQTT托管形态设备和</ph></props>MQTT云网关设备，自定义Topic为设备的原始自定义Topic。详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433806.html。
对于<props="china"><ph>非开源MQTT托管形态设备和</ph></props>非MQTT云网关设备，自定义Topic的格式为`/broadcast/${productKey}/${自定义字段}`。其中`${productKey}`与请求参数ProductKey值一致，`${自定义字段}`为您自定义的任意字段。

<notice> 
Topic是在设备开发时编码定义的，无需控制台创建。
Topic的操作权限必须为订阅或发布和订阅。

</notice>
